test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which among the following mirror(s) always forms virtual and erect image?

(A) Convex mirror

(B) Plane mirror

(C) Concave mirror
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concave mirrors can also form virtual and erect images depending on the position of the object.**
 
• **Convex mirrors always form virtual and diminished images, which are smaller than the actual size of the object.**
 
• Plane mirrors always form virtual and erect images, which are the same size as the actual object.
 
• The key term mentioned in the question is "virtual and erect image," which means that the image formed is upright and appears to be behind the mirror.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The law of reflection explains why a mirror is classified as a reflecting surface.**
 
• **The reflected images with regular dimensions that are flipped from left to right are the images created by a plane mirror.**
 
• The spherical mirrors with an outward curve are called convex mirrors.
 
• The spherical mirrors that are bent inward are called concave mirrors.
